findings.detail: Qualification requires formula-error freedom and a formula in a located derived semantic output cell. Decorative formulas do not qualify; named-reference formulas can qualify without A1 precedents.

Each complete dashboard view co-locates six service/exception/cost metrics and a capacity signal on one sheet. Every detected complete view must reconcile; identical duplicate views pass and conflicting views fail.

Dashboard associations support Metric/Value columns at arbitrary separation, transposed Metric/Value rows, and bounded standalone label cards. Structural associations take precedence only for nonempty bound pairs. No sheet-name requirement is used.
Percent-suffixed values parse exactly once; numeric values under explicit percent labels are percentage points; numeric utilization/rate values are fractions. The magnitude heuristic was removed.
Dashboard structural extraction is not used by generic cost/scenario metricValue. This prevents column headers such as Holding Cost or Production Units from shadowing authoritative totals.

Missing dashboard declares rendering, cross-sheet consistency, and all ten changed-input/scenario probes. Stale dashboard declares cross-sheet consistency and all ten probes. Receipt mutant keeps the intended invalid date as an Excel numeric serial.
Source and freshly compiled suite modules contain the exact Planner snapshot and suite digests listed above; checked-in member pins remain constants rather than runtime catalog derivations.

Current bytes preserve selection before createRun side effects, exact whole-suite failure rather than shrinkage, ordinary case-by-harness run planning, durable run/execution suite identity, reopen behavior, mandatory gates, and sanitized catalog projection.
